The PKGBUILD downloads from the official vendor (www.segger.com) with pinned MD5 checksums, performs standard file operations in prepare()/package() functions, and has no top-level code execution. learnings: API errors should be distinguished from security inconclusiveness - tool failures should not trigger re-audit when another model provides complete coverage
Desktop .desktop files are low-risk and can be batch-audited or deprioritized when many are present
Models should handle API failures gracefully by retrying or marking files as 'skipped due to error' rather than 'inconclusive'
